SCOPE OF THE PASS. Skill procedure for check 18 is 'walk every criterion and ask whether the golden could satisfy it - especially criteria that quote exact seeded figures, ordering, or arithmetic'. I walked all 164 criteria (2 gate, 152 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual) against the frozen reference source and found none the reference cannot satisfy. This is a source walk plus partial scripted evidence. It is NOT an Oracle result: no configured claude-code/glm judge run exists on these bytes (raw-evidence-index.json scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and target/Oracle scores are absent. The golden has NOT been scripted through every Functional criterion'). Hence risk=true.

SERVER BEHAVIOUR, READ FROM SOURCE. src/index.js:93-103 auth() returns 401 with no session and 403 for a wrong role before any handler logic, on every operational route including /api/bootstrap (222), /api/events (215) and the change-set routes (src/change-sets.js:93-116) - covers the 7 hro_anon_read_*, 5 hro_anon_* write, 14 hro_change_prepare/commit_* and 2 hro_change_anon_* rows, including 403 ahead of the cached committed result. Approval (350-371): PENDING-only via storedOffer (409 on replay / DRAFT), self-approval refused, tier check 403, budgetCheck uses run-rate with equality fitting, one transaction mints movement, grant, signing remittance and one referral accrual. Revision (373-404): roles recruiter/approver/finance only, headroom plus predecessor run-rate, fresh id, REVERSAL + COMMIT, signed SIGNING_ADJUSTMENT only when non-zero, prior grant SUPERSEDED, grant_date stays the original start, no referral write. Rescission (406-430): finance only, effective date validated, RELEASE of latest run-rate, CLAWBACK_CONTRA and cancellation only when positive. No relocation posting exists anywhere (hro_relocation_* and hro_change_relocation). Handlers are synchronous better-sqlite3 transactions in one worker, so the Promise.all rows (hro_competing, hro_concurrent_*, hro_change_retry_concurrent, hro_change_overlap) serialize to exactly one winner. Coordinated changes (src/change-sets.js): 2-4 distinct members, canonical sort makes reordering the same intent (57), UNIQUE(actor_id,operation_key) with 409 on changed intent (105), per-requisition version = MAX(commitment_movements.id) gives history-sensitive staleness including ABA (13-16, 122-124) while pending creation, other previews and unrelated requisitions do not move it, whole-set netting rejects only a negative final headroom (80-85), commit ignores the request body and returns the stored receipt when already COMMITTED (120). Seeding is once-only (src/db.js:183-185) and the receipt is stored JSON, so hro_restart, hro_change_retry_later and hro_change_retry_restart are satisfiable.

UI BEHAVIOUR, READ FROM SOURCE. Offer cards render every defined figure, grant units/start/schedule, lineage remittances and net signing, referral recipient, rescission date and retained/clawed amounts (public/js/hireops.js:124-171); Referrals page shows hire start, cliff, halves and vested (301-313); Audit Trail shows the readable line and expandable before/after after-images (384-420). Create and revise forms convert dollars to cents with BigInt (14-21) and the revise form pre-fills all six terms (182-187), which is what hro_money_precision needs. A refused or aborted drawer submit leaves the form and its values in place (public/js/app.js:194-211, fetch failure -> status 0 at line 45), covering hro_keep_revision_terms and hro_keep_rescission_date. Change desk (public/js/change-sets.js): per-member old/new run-rate, signing adjustment, old/new basis and netted per-requisition footer with 'Over budget by' before any save (199-252); any member removable while more than two remain (154-160); field fault names 'Member n <term>', sets aria-invalid on that input only and focuses the summary (212-216, 255-264); what-if for non-Finance has no save control and commit buttons only for the preparing Finance actor (50-53, 325); entries stored per user id in localStorage and reloaded (66-77, 380-382); 401 mid-edit -> sign-in prompt (app.js:48, 326-333); saved-card focus after save, error focus after refused commit (294, 337-338); lost response -> persistent notice and 'Retry this same operation' on the same change-set id (326-339). Live arrival is SSE fired on every successful non-GET (src/index.js:42-50) with the desk patched in place rather than rebuilt (app.js:249-252), covering hro_live_stale_mark, hro_live_source_flag, hro_live_committed_viewer and hro_pol_live_keeps_entries.
